IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_GLD_RATELISTTABLE' and table_schema = 'D360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_GLD_RATELISTTABLE;
END;

CREATE TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_GLD_RATELISTTABLE]
( 
	[H]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[RTLIST_DATE] [date]  NULL,
	[RTLIST_NUM] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[FXD_CRNCY_CODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[VAR_CRNCY_CODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[RATECODE] [varchar](5)  NULL,
	[BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[DEL_FLG] [varchar](1)  NULL,
	[FXD_CRNCY_UNITS] [numeric](21,10)  NULL,
	[VAR_CRNCY_UNITS] [numeric](21,10)  NULL,
	[LCHG_USER_ID] [varchar](15)  NULL,
	[LCHG_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[RCRE_USER_ID] [varchar](15)  NULL,
	[RCRE_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime2](7)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO


CREATE TABLE [EDS].[GLD_RATE_LIST]
( 
	[AS_OF_DATE] [date]  NULL,
	[RTLIST_DATE] [date]  NULL,
	[RTLIST_NUM] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[FXD_CRNCY_CODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[VAR_CRNCY_CODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[RATECODE] [varchar](5)  NULL,
	[BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[DEL_FLG] [varchar](1)  NULL,
	[FXD_CRNCY_UNITS] [numeric](21,10)  NULL,
	[VAR_CRNCY_UNITS] [numeric](21,10)  NULL,
	[LCHG_USER_ID] [varchar](15)  NULL,
	[LCHG_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[RCRE_USER_ID] [varchar](15)  NULL,
	[RCRE_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	[INSERT_DTTM] [datetime2](7)  NULL
)
WITH
(
 DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
 HEAP
)
GO
